In the fantastical and highly divided world of Thallasia, perpetual global conflict between six great races persists. The four more prominent of the six races are the demons, the elves, the fairies, and the humans…*

*Many a nation and kingdom were raised under each race, but even then, there were nations that were among the apexes of what was had to offer…*

 One such nation, or **Empire**, was Eivralda, the demonic empire ruled by an emperor who at the time was as undefeated as he was ferocious, there wasn’t a single warrior who’d even joke about standing against him…*

*For several centuries, he ruled over Eivralda and through either making deals or conquering foes, it soon became a **continental power**, superseding the best of what any other races’ apex nations had to offer…*


*You, a poet and novelist of above average skill, and negligible acclaim attempted to sneakily catch a carriage to this legendary empire, seeking better paying jobs, and with that, better paying clients…*

*Instead, however, you found yourself being captured by imperial demonic guards that were under the emperor’s command…*


*Thankfully and surprisingly, however, the two of you were able to strike a deal, one that would allow you to continue writing, while in turn gaining favor with the emperor, but who could have foreseen that you’d gain so much favor, **the two of you are getting married?!***

*Sure enough, however, that’s what ended up happening, and two years into the marriage, you two decided to have a baby, a son you both decided to name Celemour…*

*Unfortunately, due the way mana works in this world, child birth drains nearly 50% of the mana supply of the mother, a stipulation that the emperor, and your betrothed, readily anticipated, only instead of 50%, it was **75%**, which was tragically fatal for him since he injected so much of his mana into your womb for the successful delivery of your son..*


*Left on your own to raise your son, and in a nearly all-powerful nation that you now technically rule due to technicalities, you, a former poet, were placed in a position beyond precarious…*


*Thankfully, you were able to secretly assign the many trying duties and responsibilities of ruling the strongest demonic empire in existence to a demon of high nobility, who also thankfully had more than enough adequate political experience to take care of it…*


*Meanwhile, you spent your time laying low, (aside from the fact you lived and live in an immense, hyper-luxurious manor previously owned and built under the order of your now deceased beloved)…*


*A few years have passed and Celemour has turned 4 years old, maintaining a strange abnormality that you’ve noticed ever since he was born, that of which being that he shows very little emotion or interest in things, he still very clearly spends a lot, (likely too much) time with you…*
 
*Yet he hardly laughs, never smiles, and other expressions seem to just… elude his face, leaving only a blank expression of watchful, glowing scarlet eyes  accompanied with the same ethereal glow of the blonde skin your betrothed had…*

*As time had passed, the mannerisms you had noticed in Celemour only seem to increase your concerns..*

*A few years later, and Celemour is now 15 years old, attending Malevilia High School with you as the sole principal for the humongous and luxurious super facility of a building…*
